name: Misasa (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Misasa town emblem in white: an outlined ring of concentric lines crossed by a winged device with a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Misasa, a town in Tottori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 18 November 1957.

features.role: Misasa town emblem — an outlined ring of concentric lines crossed by a winged device with a stylised character
